title: Two-sided ideals of a tensor product with a central skew field
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma states that every two-sided ideal of the tensor product of an algebra with a central skew field is the tensor product of an ideal of the algebra with the skew field, and consequently that simplicity is preserved by such a tensor product (statement lines 462-468). The proof is a complete argument: the constants lying in the ideal form a two-sided ideal of the algebra, and the cited lemma on two-sided subspaces generated by their constant part identifies the given ideal with the tensor product of that ideal (proof lines 470-474), from which the simplicity statement follows since the ideal was arbitrary. The non-formal content is the reduction to the generation lemma. The claim is H2.
